chunks: We had seized them with the punishment, but they did not bow before their Lord nor turned to Him in humility,

key_terms.يَتَضَرَّعُونَ: they supplicate with humility and desperation

ai.seo_question: Why did the disbelievers not submit to God during their punishment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the spiritual stubbornness (istikbar) of those who, despite experiencing divine trials, fail to achieve true humility (tadarru'). It underscores the distinction between mere physical affliction and the internal submission of the heart, a key theme in the concept of divine testing (ibtila).
